title: Locally closed exceptional comparison under site comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $s:S\hookrightarrow T$ be a locally closed immersion (a closed immersion followed by an open immersion) [def-weil-closed-immersion] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Choose a factorization $s=v\circ c$, with $c:S\hookrightarrow V$ closed and $v:V\hookrightarrow T$ open [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on either small site $	au=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], put $F_	au=v_{	au,!}c_{	au,*}$ and $J_	au=Rc_	au^!v_	au^*$, using extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero] and the ambient closed right adjoints [lem-exc-closed-ambient, lem-exc-proetale-closed-support]. Give $F_	au\dashv J_	au$ the pasted adjunction, with counit $\epsilon^	au$ [lem-cat-right-adjoint-composition]. Write $
u_W$ for the etale/pro-etale site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $G_s=
u_S^*s^	imes R
u_{T,*}$ for the transported compact-support right adjoint [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

For $M\in D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], $J_{\mathrm{et}}M$ is bounded below. Composing open restriction comparison with the closed exceptional comparison gives a natural isomorphism
$$\gamma_M:
u_S^*J_{\mathrm{et}}M\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_T^*M.$$
Let $\Delta_L:
u_T^*F_{\mathrm{et}}L\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_S^*L$ be the composite of the canonical closed direct-image and open extension-by-zero comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] for bounded-below etale $L$. Then
$$\epsilon^{\mathrm{proet}}_{
u_T^*M}\circ F_{\mathrm{proet}}(\gamma_M)\circ\Delta_{J_{\mathrm{et}}M}=
u_T^*(\epsilon^{\mathrm{et}}_M).$$
Under the counit-compatible identification $J_{\mathrm{et}}\cong s^	imes$, the value $J_{\mathrm{proet}}
u_T^*M$ and its adjunction maps on bounded-below etale-origin test objects identify with $G_s(
u_T^*M)$ and its comparison-class adjunction [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. The identification of $
u_S^*J_{\mathrm{et}}M$ with this transported value is $
u_S^*s^	imes(\eta_M)$, where $\eta_M:M\xrightarrow{\sim}R
u_{T,*}
u_T^*M$ is the site-comparison unit [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. The resulting comparisons are independent of the factorization through the canonical adjunction-composition identifications, and their units and counits are the pasted ones.

proof.text: Construct the Noetherian hypotheses and the quasi-compact immersion from finite type over the field. Choose the ordinary closed adjoints, with the canonical open complement on the pro-etale side. Exact open inverse image followed by the right adjoint to exact closed direct image preserves a lower bound of every bounded constructible input.

Construct the natural transformation gamma by transposing the inverse specified Delta followed by the comparison image of the etale pasted counit. Adjunction naturality proves its naturality. The adjunction inverse law proves its specified counit identity. Its components are isomorphisms by lem-sf-locally-closed-counit-comparison.

Define rho_M=C_S(r_M X(eta_M)), with the actual closure right-adjoint comparison r. Its naturality follows from r and eta. The comparison unit is invertible on bounded-below M, so rho is invertible componentwise. Define transport=gamma.symm ≪≫ asIso rho. Cancellation proves unit_normalization; lem-sf-locally-closed-relative-hom-identity supplies precisely relative_hom. This constructs the existing comparison structure without changing its fields.

For the factorization theorem, equality of c ≫ v and c′ ≫ v′ identifies the closure exceptional functors X and X′, including their proof-valued instance arguments. Write r:J_e ≅ X and r′:J′_e ≅ X for the specified counit-compatible identifications, and θ,θ′ for the two transport maps. Set e_e=r ≪≫ r′.symm and e_p=θ ≪≫ θ′.symm. Cancellation proves both normalization equalities. Postcompose the gamma square with θ′; the two unit_normalization equations reduce it to C_S(r r′⁻¹) C_S(r′ X(η)) = C_S(r X(η)), which follows by functoriality and inverse cancellation. Finally either normalization uniquely determines its component by cancellation, proving existence and uniqueness of the pair. A private lemma proves this calculation in arbitrary categories before specializing it to the scheme functors; no extra comparison or adjunction is assumed.
